name: paper_trading_scorecard_default
description: Default thresholds for comparing Alpaca paper-trading sessions against expected backtest behavior.
review_notes: Compare broker fills against expected backtest fills by order id when available.
Flag sessions with unresolved broker reconciliation items before trusting paper results.
Treat missing account equity as not available rather than an automatic scorecard failure.
Use this scorecard after each paper session before a strategy remains promoted.
